# Floor & Decor Opens New Store in Porter Ranch, California


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_cbb801d0e7ff7345df625ad52b2e6a4b/flooranddecor/news/2026-11-19_Floor_Decor_Opens_New_Store_in_Porter_Ranch_314.pdf) November 19, 2026 4:35pm EST


*—Leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring brings its expansive in-stock selection and warehouse-format shopping experience to Porter Ranch—*


ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), a leading specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring for professionals and homeowners, today announced the opening of its newest warehouse store and design center in Porter Ranch, California, at 19819 Rinaldi Street.


The Porter Ranch store opens with a team of approximately 40 associates led by Emanuel Rivera, the store’s Chief Executive Merchant.


The new store gives Porter Ranch-area homeowners and professionals local access to a broad assortment of in-stock tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone options, along with installation materials, decorative accessories and related categories at everyday low prices.


“We’re proud to bring Floor & Decor to Porter Ranch,” said Rivera. “This new store reflects our continued commitment to providing homeowners and professionals with great products, expert guidance, and strong value, all in one place. We can’t wait to connect with the community and be a trusted resource for their home projects.”


The new Porter Ranch store opens to customers today, with a ribbon cutting ceremony and official grand opening celebration to follow on Wednesday, November 25. The festivities will continue in the new year with a 30 Days of Deals Celebration from Monday, January 11, through Tuesday, February 9, 2027.


**Ribbon Cutting Ceremony**


Floor & Decor will celebrate its grand opening with a ribbon cutting ceremony on Wednesday, November 25, at 10 a.m. PT, in partnership with the Northwest Valley Chamber of Commerce.


**30 Days of Deals Celebration**


The Porter Ranch store will extend its grand opening celebration with 30 days of special offers, giveaways, and in-store events in the new year. From January 11 through February 9, 2027, customers can enjoy:


- **Limited Time Savings:** 15% off select installation materials and trim*
- **Weekly $1,000 Gift Card Giveaway:** One $1,000 gift card will be given away each week, for five gift cards in total, with drawings held January 17, 23 and 30 and February 6, and a final drawing on February 10, following the close of registration on February 9. Customers can register in store daily for a chance to win**
- **Free Breakfast Mondays:** Free breakfast every Monday from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m., January 11 through February 8, while supplies last
- **Daily Giveaways:** Free items for the first 100 customers each day, while supplies last, with a new item each week:


- January 11–16: Tote Bag
- January 17–23: Bucket
- January 24–30: Hat
- January 31–February 6: Lunch Box
- February 7–9: T-shirt


- **Vendor Demonstrations:** Vendor representatives will be in the store from 7 a.m. to noon to provide demonstrations, answer questions, and share product information:


- **MAPEI:** January 11–15
- **Schluter:** January 20 and 22
- **wedi:** January 25–29
- **LATICRETE:** February 1–5


**Store Facts**


- Location: 19819 Rinaldi Street, Porter Ranch, CA 91326
- Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. PT
- Phone Number: (818) 213-1870
- The store will be closed on Thursday, November 26 (Thanksgiving Day), and on Thursday, December 24 and Friday, December 25 (Christmas Eve and Christmas Day)


*Offer valid for all purchases of Grout, Mortar, Tools & Accessories, Surface Preparation Material, Self Leveler, Sealers, Cleaners, Uncoupling Membranes, Backer Board, Shower Systems, Primer, Floor Heating, Drains, Waterproofing, Niches, Pan Liners, Profiles and Trims, Caulk, Vents and Registers, Adhesives, Underlayment, Moldings, Stair Treads & Stair Parts at the Porter Ranch Floor & Decor location between 1/11/2027 and 2/9/2027. Offer valid in-store only and not available for online purchases made at flooranddecor.com. Limited to current in-store stock. Offer not valid on previous purchases. Cannot be combined with any other offer, coupon, or discount.


**No purchase necessary to enter or win. A purchase does not increase your chances of winning. Open to legal residents of CA who reside within 250 miles of Porter Ranch, CA who are 18 years of age or older at the time of entry. Void where prohibited. See complete Official Rules at[www.flooranddecor.com/porterranchpro](http://www.flooranddecor.com/porterranchpro) for details including entry periods, eligibility restrictions, prize description and ARV. Registration location: Floor & Decor, 19819 Rinaldi Street, Porter Ranch, CA 91326. Sweepstakes registration is open during normal store hours and begins on 1/11/2027 and ends on 2/9/2027.


**About Floor & Decor Holdings, Inc.**


Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard-surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of September 24, 2026, the Company operated 282 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
